title: Relay bridge provider adapter
goal: Clean-room client for Relay's cross-chain USDG<->Circle USD bridge, with --dry-run support.
steps: Implement typed client functions for POST /quote/v2 and GET /intents/status/v3 against https://api.relay.link
Cover both bridge directions: Robinhood USDG (4663) -> Solana Circle USD (792703809) outbound, and the reverse for return
Add a --dry-run mode: quotes are read-only and always allowed; execution is refused unless liveMode is explicitly true

Add a quote-vs-execution differential check: the adapter compares the executed amount from /intents/status/v3 against the originally quoted amount and flags the delta explicitly, rather than trusting the quote as final

Add callback/status authentication: an /intents/status/v3 response is only accepted if it authenticates back to the specific intent digest this adapter itself submitted, never matched loosely by chain/asset/amount alone
Add exact-refund handling: a partial-fill or refund response produces an exact accounted amount (not an estimate), surfaced as a typed result the caller must handle explicitly
Add reentrancy/venue-failure isolation: a Relay outage, timeout, or malformed response fails the adapter call cleanly with a typed error, never leaves the caller able to infer the bridge succeeded

Add a test feeding a recorded partial-fill/refund fixture response through the real adapter code path (not a hand-authored journal entry) and assert it produces the recordDegradedReturn-eligible signal that WP-03/WP-23's DEGRADED path consumes — this closes the gap between the adapter's own failure semantics and the on-chain DEGRADED recovery path
Record fixture responses for CI; add a separate live-read-only /chains smoke test, non-blocking in CI
acceptance: Both bridge directions have a typed client function
No test in the default CI run executes a live quote
depositEnabled is checked for both currencies/chains before a quote is trusted
A quote-vs-execution amount mismatch is detected and surfaced, not silently accepted
An /intents/status/v3 response that does not authenticate to the submitted intent digest is rejected
A recorded partial-fill/refund fixture, run through the real adapter, produces the exact same DEGRADED-eligible signal WP-03/WP-23 already test against
notes: The first real quote this adapter executes is itself an ask-first action for the owner to approve before dry-run graduates to live.
